name: Walmart

basis.note: Walmart counts 90 days after purchase or upon receipt. The purchase date is the earlier of the two, so it's used.

outcome.note: Refund timing depends on the payment method used.

requirement.note: The official page doesn't say whether a mail return must be started, shipped or received by the deadline.

conditions.value: Most items within 90 days. Shorter windows: consumer electronics 30 days, most wireless phones 14 days, major appliances 2 days.

processing.note: Depends on the payment method; exact consumer timing not confirmed on the official page.

value.without: A photo ID can be used for a return without a receipt if it matches Walmart's records.

timing.note: Depends on the payment method; not confirmed on the consumer page.

fees.label: Marketplace restocking fee
fees.amount: Up to 20%, at the seller's choice

methods.label: Return at a Walmart store
steps: Bring the item to the customer service desk at any Walmart store

methods.label: Start the return online
steps: Open Purchase history in your Walmart account
Choose the item and start a return
Pick one of the return options offered for that item
methods.note: Which options are offered depends on the item.

marketplace.value: Items from Marketplace sellers: 30 days for most items and 14 days for listed electronics (tablets, computers, digital cameras, prepaid and post-paid phones). The seller may charge a restocking fee of up to 20%.

unknowns.note: No Walmart+ change to the return window found on the official pages.
No 2026 holiday return extension published yet.
The full non-returnable list wasn't confirmed in this check.

research: Official US pages read through web-search excerpts on 2026-10-11 (direct page downloads were blocked from the build environment). Spot-check before launch.
